answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier checks that every proof passes through the prism of non-replayable nonce tracking to prevent identity pooling. Each solution must be as dense as fine timber, proving that the compute cycle was dedicated exclusively to the identity slot. If the verifier detects a lagoon of recurring bits that suggests shared computation, it triggers an immediate account revocation with no refund.
